show.description: "Billionaire Baap Ka Badla" is a story of a poor young man unknowingly works inside the empire that once abandoned him. Betrayed by love and robbed of his invention, he is publicly humiliated. At the moment of his lowest fall, fate reveals he is the lost heir to a powerful dynasty. Watch Now.
